statement: A feature turned on by a property or by the host's classpath never runs without what it needs (its module, its REQUIRED listener, its Redis connection): startup fails and names what to add. A module no feature uses needs nothing: a service behind a gateway (`cosec.pipeline.mode=gateway`) with JWT off, which wires no Redis data plane, starts without Redis although `cosec-cocache` is on its classpath. What a feature needs is checked as well as its module: a web host with CoSec on registers one of CoSec's gates (a filter of the three adapters, found by type, as a bean or a filter registration), and `cosec.control.enabled=true` fails startup in `gateway` mode, which wires no control plane (DR1-G-5, DR1-G-6).
